import numpy as np, time
u, L = 4096, 16

t=time.time()
for k in range(L):
    c=T[:,k]
    anchors += (c[:,None]==c[None,:])
print('broadcast anchors', time.time()-t)
anchors2=np.zeros((u,u),dtype=np.int8)
t=time.time()
for k in range(L):
    v=T[:,k]
    order=np.argsort(v,kind='stable'); sv=v[order]
    b=np.flatnonzero(sv[1:]!=sv[:-1])+1

        if e-s>1:
            idx=order[s:e]

# duplicate-heavy case
